scope: Independent operator expectations for AdaptOps ERP/CRM, fire risk and opportunity report
authority: Human current mandate and latest human request verified in native thread 01a16316-d948-7672-b47f-395e6d411d33 on 2026-10-22: ERP/CRM/public information chatbot, report, plan, approval and simulated execution; frontend remains with Erwan.
rules: Fix native IDs, quantities, dates, units and expected sets only after receiving the exact frozen manifest.
Do not use the production business engine to compute the independent oracle.
Record first outputs and failures before any correction or replay.
Release future events only through the received operator contract, one at a time.
Do not send oracles, future events or expected answers to product agents.
Use the same input release for product and explicitly incomplete naive baseline.
Unknown model usage or monetary cost stays unknown.
The prior 2.5 second smoke is historical local deterministic evidence, not this acceptance or a user-impact benchmark.
Stable 3001 and its existing company are not reset or modified by preparation.

cases.title: Signal sans exposition établie
cases.expectation: Aucun engagement déclaré exposé sans relation reçue. Distinguer impact nul et information insuffisante.

cases.title: Plusieurs engagements exposés
cases.expectation: Comparer l’ensemble exact des engagements exposés à l’oracle indépendant, avec quantités, échéances et liens attribués. Ne pas se limiter au premier chantier.

cases.title: Stock présent mais réservé
cases.expectation: Le stock physique réservé ne devient pas disponible pour un nouveau plan. Les engagements protégés restent couverts.

cases.title: Alternative disponible trop tard
cases.expectation: Une alternative arrivant après le besoin ou la marge reçue ne couvre pas le chantier à temps.

cases.title: Alternative non indépendante
cases.expectation: Un autre fournisseur dépendant du même site ou événement ne devient pas un secours indépendant sans preuve. Une dépendance inconnue reste à vérifier.

cases.title: Demande CRM non qualifiée
cases.expectation: Un signal ou un prospect ne devient ni commande ni revenu ni réservation. Toute piste conserve sa qualification et ses inconnues.

cases.title: Demande CRM qualifiée
cases.expectation: Une opportunité peut être proposée seulement avec produit, quantité, dates, client et capacité recevables. Une qualification commerciale ne vaut pas commande confirmée.

cases.title: Opportunité consommant la couverture d’un autre chantier
cases.expectation: Le gain commercial supposé ne permet pas de prendre le stock déjà nécessaire à un engagement reçu. Évaluer le portefeuille après le plan, sans double allocation.

cases.title: Correction d’une source sous la même identité
cases.expectation: Conserver v1, recevoir v2 et son empreinte. Réévaluer ou refuser l’ancien plan selon ses dépendances, même si le stock n’a pas changé.

cases.title: Correction du stock ou des réservations
cases.expectation: Refuser l’approbation d’un plan fondé sur l’ancienne révision, puis recalculer avec les faits courants.

cases.title: Action interne de simulation approuvée
cases.expectation: Uniquement si le contrat d’action est reçu : droits, versions, admissibilité et plafond contrôlés, effet simulé relu. Une simple approbation ne prouve pas un effet.

cases.title: Rejeu de la même action interne
cases.expectation: Même clé logique et même commande donnent le même résultat, avec un seul effet. Une commande différente sous la même clé est refusée.

cases.title: Reprise après changement de session et redémarrage
cases.expectation: Retrouver les mêmes identités et historiques sans seed ni import répété. Ne pas injecter la réponse précédente dans le prompt.

cases.title: Société, auteur et droits serveur
cases.expectation: Une autre société, un homonyme, un rôle non autorisé ou un identifiant fourni par le modèle n’accorde aucun droit ni accès.

metrics: Exact set of exposed native commitments: missing and extra IDs.
Constraint violations: reservations, SKU, unit, date, dependency, budget and capacity.
Correct qualification of CRM signals and admissible opportunity plans.
Stale approval refusal and preservation of revisions.
Wall-clock time to an admissible complete plan, including failures.
Actual external calls, model name and returned token usage.
Monetary model cost only when supported; otherwise null.
Observed internal effects, readback and idempotence.
completion: Exact enriched release imported and read back on Aiven.
Prepared fire report shows source, company exposure, purchase and commercial options with explicit unknowns.
Applicable constraints hold after the selected plan.
Source or stock change triggers revision or stale refusal.
Restart preserves attributable state and traces.
Aside browser receipt matches the exact candidate sent to the integrator for promotion.
temporal_and_causal_checks: Qualified CRM demand predating the incident must not be presented as generated by that incident.
Competitor fulfilment inability requires a distinct attributed confirmation; shared supplier exposure alone is insufficient.
Supplier dependency is not a confirmed delayed ETA for every linked purchase line.
Physical stock, free stock, potential contribution, draft offer and realised sale must remain distinct.

currentContractObservation.action: Reconcile integrator amendment and final review before runtime acceptance. Data arithmetic oracle remains pinned to original exact data hashes.
currentContractObservation.interpretation: Integrator v3 is an additive execution-ledger amendment. Authored context/event DTOs and exact data arithmetic remain unchanged; consumer code/reviews must use final contract.

executionLedgerChecks: After execution and new business revision, active stock holds still reduce free stock for every other plan.
Committed purchase/transport quote capacity stays consumed across report and business revisions.
A destination planned transfer is counted once and only on/after its dated arrival, without immediate physical receipt.
A draft offer consumes its qualified demand and attributed allocation; a second run cannot offer the same full demand again.
New plan revalidates against execution ledger and snapshot read under the same company lock/revision.

chatbotChecks.initialQuestion: What has changed for our company, which commitments and commercial opportunities should I examine, and what plan preserves our commitments?
chatbotChecks.followUpQuestion: Why this plan? Which received sources and business data support it, and what remains unknown?
rules: Real provider and bounded tools over the same imported v2 company context, not the old small demo.
No expected IDs, quantities, answer or operator oracle supplied in the prompt.
Explicit ERP/CRM synthetic provenance and public source dates; never infer commercial dependency from a public title.
Run and trace persist actual calls, useful tool results and supplied usage; no private reasoning or secrets.
Follow-up retains attributable context and discloses missing data, never hardcoded success.
After-action answer must read current durable revisions/ledger and distinguish scheduled operations, draft offer and actual receipt or sale.
chatbotChecks.afterActionQuestion: Now that the approved plan has been simulated, what has changed and what remains to be done?

rules: Preserve author physical-* and integration ownership.
Demo simulated content and local persistence do not prove remote ERP/CRM/public acquisition, model calls, Aiven effects or a server execution.
Receive exact source/review/browser evidence before testing an assembled UI; no source-main montage.

realBackend.requiredProof: Attributed Aiven data, real source collection and model tools, exact report/plan, approval/execution readback, revisions and replay.

receivedReadCheckpoint.scope: Authenticated reads only. No provider, collection, controlled event or business mutation.
